transcript: Where do amino acids get linked together? At the P site. The tRNA in the P site holds the chain. A new tRNA waits in the A site with its amino acid. Snap. A peptide bond links the two amino acids. That bond forms at the P site. Like adding a bead to a necklace. The peptide bond forms at the P site. Swipe.
